definitions.P: Each arm uses its own P2 focus distance for the same subject.
definitions.G: All arms use the GT focus distance.
definitions.paired_base: Same arm, same focus mode, F2.
definitions.recovery_fraction: (Query - F2) / (S2@0.90 - F2) in per-scene dB; identify scene denominators below 0.1 dB.
definitions.rods: visible and loss_zone == 0, native 512, f001/f030/f060. Error = |decoded rho − GT center rho|. Gap = rho_f − rho_b from the clipped component means, in m^-1.

B.geometry: E-H2 v1@2k EMA + existing retrained tear

C.geometry: E-H2 v2@4k EMA + existing retrained tear

D.geometry: E-H2 v3@4k EMA + matched new tear

calibration.scope: Initial 3c V0 replay plus the same case measured with A v2a and Query; the historical 60 dB visible-only count used the superseded threshold.

interface.observed: 3c substitutes only the target depth. Source feature geometry uses observation-derived aligned SHARP for B development and the original observation path for legacy. The candidate builder takes one target depth and does not consume E component IDs or a tear field separately.
interface.target_depth: E's selected component is represented by its single decoded target depth.

confirmed.source: 3c estimated observed depth and other source attributes
confirmed.target: Each arm decoded integral center depth
confirmed.query_band: Use each arm target depth and the applicable P or G focus distance
confirmed.tear: Use in visible subpixels and maximum per-pixel subpixel depth for Query and witness placement
confirmed.comparison: Newly queried and removed counts divided by A query-pixel count over matched cases

archived_far_references.scene_details:
See source optical.

..far_witness_comparison.methods..primary_reference.by_scene.

D_diagnostic_only.dev003_far_subject_definition: P2 nominal far subject mask; GT P2 focus is reciprocal of the GT center inverse-depth median on this same mask.

config.selection: Minimize the mean of weighted edge error and global false-step tear rate; ties use weighted error, then earliest step

definitions.single: visible & ~valid_dual; optical mask also requires g*(1-w_f)>0.05
definitions.rear_error: Raw, pre-order-clipping log inverse depth minus single_back_target or log GT depth2 inverse for dual. Single target tracks the same arm's allowable front-ordered center.
definitions.component_medians: Forward clipped inverse-depth component p50 and beta exp in m^-1. Residual is log inverse depth, saturation |tanh|>0.95. Applied residual is raw back minus log beta.
definitions.normal: loss_zone==2, excluding the boundary band; gap is loss_zone==1
definitions.subject: Same nominal P2 far-subject mask as optical evaluation. Hardest gap scenes are ranked by D full-scene absolute raw rear log-inverse-depth error p50 over all visible gap pixels.
definitions.rods: Rod is visible & loss_zone==0. Dual rod is the layered edge, single rod is its interior by the cached split. Panel scenes rank by largest D-minus-C pooled dual rear error p50 across development and holdout. Each panel uses the frame with its largest paired delta.
definitions.optical: Compare stitched C/D with F2 and then S2 against Cycles in display RGB. Positive excess = per-pixel max(S2 SSE−F2 SSE,0); shares use the corresponding full-frame SSE total. This is a composited error comparison; hidden existence weights are E predictions, not renderer opacity.

observations.diagnostics/figures/dev004-f030-single-s: 放大框里 C、D 都在网格间给出较高后分量质量。D 的上部选区权重下降，RGB 残差主要沿横向结构和网格边出现。G 的正向新增 SSE 图在此框内接近色标低端。
observations.diagnostics/figures/dev005-f030-single-s: 两臂在竖杆之间都给出较高后分量质量。后分量误差亮线贴着竖杆轮廓，P 和 G 的 S2 RGB 残差也在杆边较亮。S2 相对 F2 的正向误差图在这个框内较暗。
observations.diagnostics/figures/dev005-f060-rod-comp: D 的后分量逆深度在竖杆上明显更高。后分量误差由 C 的宽亮条变为 D 更窄的边缘亮线，放大框内同时存在误差增大和减小的位置。
observations.diagnostics/figures/training-111-f001-ro: D 的斜杆后分量逆深度升高，后分量误差图的亮点沿斜线更密。前分量在相同斜线上的色阶变化较小。
observations.diagnostics/figures/training-061-f030-ro: D 的后分量逆深度在两束杆交汇处升高。D 的后分量误差亮区扩展到交汇处及其两侧，双层标签仍主要沿杆边缘。
conclusions: G 口径下，C 与 D 的单层高后分量质量掩码分别覆盖 657.2 万和 835.0 万像素。掩码内 S2 SSE 为 1853.56 和 2137.72，占各自全图 S2 SSE 的 55.84% 和 67.17%。两臂掩码面积有差别。
G 掩码内，S2 相对 F2 的逐像素正向新增 SSE 分别为 17.80 和 31.46；同时计入改善像素后，净变化为 −16.10 和 −7.12。
dev003 的主体缝隙在两臂三帧中均有超过 96% 的像素选后。f001／f060 的基底中位约 0.312 m⁻¹，后分量约 0.345–0.350 m⁻¹，GT 约 0.488–0.489 m⁻¹。f030 使用三角化的缝隙像素为 27,825，后分量中位约 0.433–0.436 m⁻¹，GT 为 0.488 m⁻¹。
缝隙单层后分量误差 p50 在开发集从 0.142 降至 0.120，在留出集从 0.082 降至 0.057。双层对应数值在开发集从 0.199 降至 0.193，在留出集从 0.085 升至 0.100。
推测 dev003 片段两端的远焦偏差与缝隙区经常选中偏低的后分量有关。本轮以既有检查点评价，原因未做独立干预验证。

observations.dev003: 栏杆间的墙色在三列里接近，隐藏颜色差主要是与竖杆对齐的细线。C 在 G 口径的 F2／S2／Query 为 32.42／31.66／32.28 dB。
observations.dev004: 蓝色网格放大框里，隐藏颜色差集中在上沿短条。C 在 G 口径上，S2 比 F2 高 4.47 dB，实际 Query 比 F2 高 0.08 dB。
observations.dev005: P 口径下 A 的亮绿竖杆明显窄于真值，B/C/D 的模糊宽度更接近真值。G 口径下 C 和 D 的 S2 均高于同臂 F2，实际 Query 均低于同臂 F2。颜色差沿竖杆和横杆交叉处最亮。
observations.dev008: 放大框里，S2 更清楚地呈现深色物体下方的黄褐色轮廓。C 在 G 口径的 F2／S2／Query 为 20.93／25.43／22.52 dB。

rod_observation: v3@4k front-selected rod error p50 increased about 6% on development and 17% on holdout; back-selected error declined. The pattern implicates front-selected error and does not support the proposed switching explanation in these statistics. The cause has not been verified.
